name: sign-in
title: Sign in
description: A passwordless sign-in and sign-up screen: work email, then a one-time code with a resend countdown, plus optional OAuth providers and SSO by work domain. Wrong, expired and rate-limited codes, blocked domains and failed providers each say what to do next.
docs: Sign in: https://uipolish.com/docs/sign-in has every state, the motion and the accessibility notes.
